APPROVE
The extraction keeps the original logic: the short-circuited `||` and pattern variable, and `return` in place of `continue`, are equivalent. Moving the nested branches and the join loop into helpers removes at least 11 complexity points from the original 25, and the code type-checks as written. I couldn't find the source tree or a .NET SDK on this machine, so I judged this from the diff alone without building it or running a complexity analyser.
